# Cleanse.ng · Professional House Cleaning in Ibadan

> Cleanse.ng is a managed residential cleaning service in Ibadan, Nigeria. Customers book online or on WhatsApp and deal with Cleanse directly, not with an individual cleaner. Each visit is carried out by one vetted, reference-checked, trained Cleanse Pro, and Cleanse provides all supplies. There are no supervisors and no cleaning teams: Cleanse manages the service centrally (scheduling, messages before and after each visit, reschedules, keys and access, feedback, complaints, renewals and payment links) and remains responsible for the service from booking to completion.

Cleanse offers regular (routine) cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, and post-fumigation cleaning for homes of 1–5 bedrooms. Pricing is flat and upfront by home size, with one-time visits or managed monthly plans (once or twice a week). Service area: Ibadan, Oyo State, including Bodija, Oluyole, Akobo, Iyaganku, Jericho, the GRA, and the University of Ibadan area.

## Key facts
- Business: Cleanse.ng (residential house cleaning service)
- Location: Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria
- Service model: fully managed by Cleanse; each visit is done by one vetted, trained Cleanse Pro; supplies included; customers contact Cleanse on WhatsApp for anything about their visits
- Booking: online at https://cleanse.ng, or WhatsApp +234 913 066 3739
- Hours: 8am–6pm daily
- Pricing (per visit): 1BR ₦5,000 · 2BR ₦8,000 · 3BR ₦12,000 · 4BR ₦15,000 · 5BR ₦20,000. Monthly plans, billed monthly. Once a week (4 visits/month): 1BR ₦15,000 · 2BR ₦20,000 · 3BR ₦30,000 · 4BR ₦40,000 · 5BR ₦50,000; twice a week (8 visits/month): 1BR ₦20,000 · 2BR ₦40,000 · 3BR ₦50,000 · 4BR ₦60,000 · 5BR ₦75,000.
